about: Build queue. Work the 'ready' items top to bottom without re-asking the owner; they are decided. 'blocked' items wait on what 'blocked_on' says. When an item is done, delete it here and add a 'done' entry to progress.json (replacing its 'planned' entry if it has one).

items.blocked_on: The advisor's true form (open question in needs.json). The hidden warlord is built (stand-in look) and drops the Key to the End, which should start this.
items.title: Campaign, part 5: the betrayal and the fight in the End
items.decided: Owner, 2026-10-07: one villain in seven disguises is each race's advisor, runs the tutorial, is revealed after the hidden warlord falls (who was trying to stop him), and is fought in the End with only your heroes and beasts against a mixed army.
spec: After the hidden warlord's dying reveal, the advisor appears, drops his disguise (short scene) and teleports the player to the End main island with only their Captains, Champions and war beasts (fallen or returning heroes come back for this fight). Rank-and-file troops stay home.
Compatibility: require the vanilla Ender Dragon to be beaten first (the End is then empty); the advisor's dragon is a Warfront 'bound dragon' entity, so the vanilla fight state isn't touched.
He holds the island with waves of mixed troops from all seven races and his own towers, in phases: army, towers and summons, then he mounts the bound dragon for the last phase.
Losing returns the player home (heroes fall as usual); the fight can be retried.
Victory: the End is freed, credits-style closing lines, a final trophy and the campaign marked complete.

items.blocked_on: Node lists for the seven race paths (open question in needs.json). The six shared paths are designed; they can be built first.
items.title: Player skill tree: Renown, six shared paths, race paths, active skill slots
items.decided: Owner, 2026-10-07: build freedom over race-locked kits. Shared playstyle paths plus one race path, Renown points from battle, small race affinity, Warfront's own system, cooldowns only.
spec: Renown: a player attachment (XP and level), synced. Gains: kills (small, more for Captains/Champions/beasts), raid or siege wave won, raider camp cleared, warlord beaten (large, plus 1 bonus skill point each). Level curve tuned so a player reaches about level 10 by base level 3 and about 25 by the end of the campaign. 1 skill point per level. Total points by the end: enough for about two and a half paths plus some of the race path.

Paths (shared by all races): Blade (melee; works with any weapon in #minecraft:swords, #minecraft:axes and spear/other melee tags, so Better Combat, Simply Swords and Epic Knights weapons all count), Bulwark (shield and armor), Marksman (bows, crossbows, tridents and thrown weapons), Arcane (boosts Iron's Spells through its attributes; without Iron's Spells, its nodes boost Warfront's own magic damage), Skirmisher (mobility and stealth), Commander (army buffs, army cap, beasts). Plus one race path per race that deepens the race power.

Nodes: about 10 per path in a short branching tree; each needs its parent. Most are passives (vanilla attribute modifiers or event hooks); 2-3 per path are active skills. Data-driven (JSON nodes in the mod's data folder) so nodes can be tuned without code.
Active skills: up to 4 equipped in skill slots (keybinds, rebindable), from any path. Cooldowns only, no new mana bar.

Race affinity: each race has 2 favored paths where the first 3 nodes cost nothing. Proposed: Human Blade + Commander, Elf Marksman + Skirmisher, Dwarf Bulwark + Blade, Orc Blade + Bulwark, Demon Arcane + Skirmisher, Angel Arcane + Bulwark, Hive Skirmisher + Commander (owner can change).
Respec: at the War Table, refund all points for Mana Crystals (cost grows with points spent).
UI: a Skill Tree screen in the ui-foundation theme (race accent color), opened from the War Table and a hotkey; skill slots on the combat HUD next to the race power; a Renown bar.
Test Panel and /wftest: grant Renown or levels, grant points, unlock any node, reset the tree.

Game tests: Renown rises from a kill and a level grants a point; a node can't be bought without its parent; a passive node applies its attribute and respec removes it; affinity nodes cost 0 for the right race.

Blade path nodes (owner-approved 2026-10-07): Keen Edge (+6% melee damage) -> Swift Hands (+10% attack speed) -> Duelist branch: Precise Strike (ACTIVE: next hit ignores armor and crits, 10 s), Executioner (+25% damage to enemies under 30% health), Bleeding Cuts (crits apply a bleed DoT); Reaver branch: Cleave (ACTIVE: wide arc hitting everything in front, 10 s), Wide Arcs (sweep hits +50%), Bloodlust (kills give +10% attack speed for 5 s, stacks 3) -> Battle Hardened (heal 2 on kill; needs either branch's last node) -> Blade Storm (ACTIVE capstone: 3 s whirl striking everything around you, 40 s). Counts any weapon in melee weapon tags.

Bulwark path nodes (owner-approved 2026-10-07): Iron Skin (+2 armor) -> Shield Training (shield raises faster, axe-disable time halved) -> Sentinel branch: Shield Wall (ACTIVE: block from every direction for 4 s, 20 s), Unshakable (+30% knockback resistance), Steel Thorns (shield blocks reflect 20% of melee damage); Vanguard branch: Shield Bash (ACTIVE: stun the first enemy in front 1.5 s, 10 s), Provoke (enemies you hit target you for 5 s), Momentum (sprinting into enemies with shield raised knocks them aside) -> Last Stand (once per 2 min a killing blow leaves you at 1 health with Resistance III for 3 s) -> Guardian's Aegis (ACTIVE capstone: for 8 s, half the damage allies within 6 blocks take is redirected to you, 60 s).

Marksman path nodes (owner-approved 2026-10-07): Steady Aim (+8% projectile damage, tighter spread) -> Quick Draw (bow draw and crossbow reload 20% faster) -> Sniper branch: Piercing Shot (ACTIVE: next shot pierces every enemy in line with +50% damage, 12 s), Hawkeye (+20% damage on hits from 20+ blocks), Headhunter (+15% damage vs Captains, Champions and bosses); Ranger branch: Volley (ACTIVE: next shot fires 5 projectiles in a cone, 14 s), Run and Gun (no movement slowdown while drawing or aiming), Retrieval (40% chance not to use ammo) -> Hunter's Mark (your hits make the target glow for 5 s and your army deals it +10% damage) -> Rain of Arrows (ACTIVE capstone: arrows rain on a 6-block area for 4 s, 45 s). Works for any item in bow, crossbow, trident and thrown-weapon tags.

Arcane path nodes (owner-approved 2026-10-07): Attunement (+5% spell power via Iron's spell_power attribute) -> Focus (-10% spell cooldowns via Iron's cooldown_reduction) -> Battlemage branch: Spellblade (ACTIVE: for 6 s, melee hits add magic damage of your race's strong Iron's school, 15 s), Arcane Armor (10% of damage taken is paid from Iron's mana instead), Mana Strike (melee hits restore a little Iron's mana); Evoker branch: Overcharge (ACTIVE: next spell +40% spell power, 20 s), Deep Well (+20% max mana, +15% mana regen), Spell Echo (10% chance a cast spell's cooldown resets) -> Ley Tap (Iron's mana regenerates 2x while inside your base's mana network, pylon range) -> Arcane Surge (ACTIVE capstone: 8 s of no mana cost and halved cooldowns, 75 s). Without Iron's Spells: spell-power nodes boost Warfront magic damage (race powers, Spellblade), mana nodes turn into skill cooldown reduction.

Skirmisher path nodes (owner-approved 2026-10-07): Fleet Foot (+8% move speed) -> Light Landing (no fall damage under 6 blocks, half above) -> Shadow branch: Vanish (ACTIVE: invisible 4 s and nearby enemies drop you as a target, 25 s), Ambush (first hit from invisibility or from behind +50% damage), Quiet Step (sneaking makes no sound or vibration, so sculk sensors and Wardens miss you); Outrider branch: Dash (ACTIVE: 6-block dash in the move direction, 2 charges, 8 s per charge), Hit and Run (after landing a hit, +20% speed for 2 s), Slippery (15% chance to dodge a melee hit) -> Opportunist (+20% damage to slowed, rooted, stunned or routing enemies) -> Shadow Dance (ACTIVE capstone: for 6 s Dash has no cooldown and hitting a new enemy makes you invisible for 1 s, 60 s).

Commander path nodes (owner-approved 2026-10-07): Formations are NOT gated: every player keeps all formations. Drillmaster (your units +5% max health) -> Logistics (+2 army cap) -> Empowerer branch: Kindle Arms (ACTIVE: for 10 s your units within 16 blocks add your race's strong-school element to their hits: Human Evocation arcane burst, Elf Nature poison, Dwarf Lightning chain spark, Orc Blood lifesteal for the unit, Demon Fire ignite, Angel Holy bonus vs undead/demons/Hive, Hive Eldritch armor shred; 30 s), Blood Bond (5% of the damage your units deal heals you), Shared Armor (units within 10 blocks gain 15% of your armor value as an attribute modifier); Warmaster branch: Call to Arms (ACTIVE: up to 6 of your units at your base teleport to your side, 90 s), Beastmaster (+1 war beast slot, never above 10), Veteran Corps (units gain veterancy XP 25% faster) -> Steady Ranks (your units within 12 blocks rout half as often) -> Last Order (ACTIVE capstone: every fallen hero of yours within 24 blocks gets up at half health, 120 s).
